title: Clarify deployment preview zip wording
summary: The Maintenance Deployment Package labels now make clear that preview planning does not write a zip.
reason: The Plan zip label implied that Plan Deployment would create a zip, even though the backend command is intentionally dry-run only.
behavior_before: The checkbox said Plan zip and the dry-run panel did not foreground that zip output is only previewed until Create Deployment runs.
behavior_after: The panel uses Preview Deployment, Zip package, and Verify package wording, and dry-run status/details explicitly say preview does not write the zip.
rollback_plan: Revert the Deployment Package label/detail copy changes and matching WebView smoke assertions.
notes:
Clarify that deployment preview does not write zip output.
Renamed dry-run controls to Preview Deployment, Zip package, and Verify package; dry-run details now say no zip is written.
